title: Changes in Filolial
text: That angel is wearing the same clothes as the villagers, isn’t she? Is she following Father’s instructions?
“Sakura-chan?”

Even I’m surprised enough to ask that. That’s strange—Sakura-chan from the future was almost the same height and build as Yuki-chan and the others. If I recall correctly, her hair was sleek and straight, and the only thing that matched her future self was that section of wavy hair that looked like a flower wreath, right?
In a nutshell, she has a figure like Filo-tan’s Big Sister. What on earth is going on here? What circumstances led to this change between last time and now?
“Sakura… you’ve grown, haven’t you?”
“Really?”
Sakura-chan is rubbing her eyes, looking sleepy.
“Naofumi, what are we doing today? Sakura’s hungry.”
“Um… Motoyasu-kun! What should I do?”

Hmm… It’s true that I’ve seen some Filolial-sama take on an appearance similar to Sakura-chan’s right now. Chick is a prime example. I know that when that particular Filolial-sama takes on an angelic form, she takes on the appearance of an adult woman. Well, it’s not something you get to see very often. It’s not that it never happens—it’s just extremely rare.

But to think there’s a change even when a Filolial-sama takes on an angelic form… This Motoyasu is full of surprises. Come to think of it, since Sakura-chan’s eye color is different this time, there might be various other differences as well.
But… I wonder why? Looking at the shade of Sakura-chan’s hair, when she’s with my Father, it gives me the illusion that Éclair is there too. Is it because their apparent ages and builds are similar?
“Motoyasu-kun, are you listening?”
“That’s right… I don’t have any knowledge of this from the future either.”
I don’t know under what conditions Sakura-chan ends up looking so grown-up, but since it’s an undeniable fact, I’ll accept it and think it over. …
“There’s no particular problem here.”
“Really!?”
“That’s right. Sakura-chan understands that too, doesn’t she?”
“Yeah! Sakura’s job is to protect Naofumi.”
Her eyes look sleepy, but she answers with strong determination.
“Ah, yeah. Thanks.”
When Father replies, Sakura-chan closes her eyes, bows her head, and stands next to him so he can pet her head.
“Boo-boo!”
It looks like Keel is protesting—what’s the matter? Father also responds to Sakura-chan’s request and pets her head.
“Well then, Sakura-chan. I’ll get your clothes ready later.”
“Ehh… That’s such a hassle…”
“You mustn’t be so selfish!”
Yuki-chan protests. Then she does a little twirl to show off the outfit I sewed for her.
“What do you think? This is a wonderful outfit that Motoyasu-sama made for me.”
“Yeah, it really suits you.”
My Father compliments Yuki-chan. What a blessing!
“Why is Motoyasu-kun saluting so happily? Well, he does have good taste. I hear he was quite the social butterfly back in the day.”
“I made some clothes for Keel, too.”
I take Keel’s outfit out of the bag and hand it to Father. He unfolds the clothes I sewed and shows them to Keel.
“Boo-boo-boo!”
Keel makes a huge fuss, protesting as loudly as he can, and backs up against the wall.
“Come on, it’s too late to start objecting now…”
“Boo-boo-boo-boo-boo!”
“Just bear with it. I think it’ll look good on you, Keel.”
“Boo-boo!”
“I’m a guy… Motoyasu thinks you’re a girl, so just give it a rest.”
“Boo-boo-boo-boo!”
“Huh? Well, if Motoyasu could understand what you’re saying, I think he’d realize you’re a guy. It seems Motoyasu-kun can’t recognize women outside of Filolial relationships with men.”
Keel is clinging to me for some reason. I don’t know about that. Or rather, you should speak properly.
“Bububububububububu-hi!”
“I have absolutely no idea what you’re saying.”
“Do you really hate the clothes Lord Motoyasu prepared that much?”
Yuki-chan is furrowing her brows in displeasure.
“Bub…”
As if at a loss for words, Keel takes a few steps back under Yuki-chan’s glare.
“More importantly, Motoyasu-kun. The way Kou is looking at Keel-kun is a little strange.”
“Keel-kun’s tail—”
“Buhi!?”
Keel fled, clinging to his Father. Sakura stepped in front of Kou, who was trotting after Keel, to block his path.
“Hmm… No way. I’m going to protect Keel, too. Just like I did with those bandits yesterday.”
“Bandits, huh?”
“Yeah. Yesterday, I was riding Sakura-chan around the area when we got attacked… They seemed to be bandits, but they were kind of suspicious, you know?”
“Yeah. During that fight, Keel and Naofumi were targeted, so Sakura protected them.”

Wow, Sakura really does shine the brightest when she’s protecting Father. Seeing her so proud makes me very happy, too. Normally, that’s something I’d have to do myself, but since I can’t be with you guys just yet…
“Sakura kept patting the defeated bandit every time he spoke—was that because he was lying?”
“Yeah. Back then, he couldn’t speak human language very well, so she’d tap anyone who was lying.”

“I suppose so. His eyes looked kind of strange, after all. That guy was disguised as a bandit… According to Motoyasu-kun, I think he’s a member of the Three Heroes Church. He was well-dressed—I guess you’d call it a contrived look?”
Hmm… At this stage, has my future Father already been attacked by bandits? I certainly don’t know all the fine details. So they were disguising themselves to avoid arousing Father’s suspicion.

If Father had caught on and ordered the Demi-Humans to destroy the Three Heroes Church, it would have led to war—so they must have attacked as a precaution. It’s fine to attack, but being attacked is a problem. I can easily imagine that kind of situation.
“Oink! Oink!”

“Keel… I’m sorry to say this, but you’re not bad-looking, you know?　Being a girl who likes to dress as a boy—by my world’s standards, that would make you look like a handsome young man, and you’ve got a good-looking face to begin with, after all.”
“Bu… Bubububu…”
“You might not like it, but I think it’ll look great on you, so just bear with it and give it a try, okay? After all, this is ultimately the way you’ll defeat the people who destroyed your village.”
“Bu… Buu…”
“Yeah. Do your best.”
Father gently strokes Keel and turns his gaze toward Sakura-chan.
“So, what should we do about Sakura-chan’s clothes? The best option would probably be to have Motoyasu-kun make her some as soon as possible.”
“In that case, we’d have to leave Sakura-chan in his care.”
“Sakura doesn’t want to leave Naofumi’s side to protect him.”
“But—”
“Well, then, we might just have to make do with regular clothes for a while.”
“Should we ask the guy at the weapon shop?”
“In the future, even the monster merchant knew about this.”
“Huh… well, let’s ask the guy at the weapon shop first.”
“Understood.”
We headed straight for the town below Melromarc Castle.
We showed Yuki, Kou, and Sakura to the guy at the weapon shop.
“Wow, this is amazing. Do Heroes actually turn Filolials into humans?”
“Is that right, Motoyasu-kun?”
“When a Hero raises a Filolial-sama, they undergo special growth.”
“So? What do you want from me?”
“Um… it seems Sakura-chan’s outfit isn’t one of those special ones made with Magical Power. We thought you might carry something like that… Apparently, they have them in the Demi-Human kingdom.”
“That’s some specialized gear. Sorry, but I don’t have anything like that in my shop.”
Sakura-chan is looking at the sword rack in my dad’s shop.
“Sakura, I want to try using a weapon.”
“W-what’s wrong?”
“Sakura, I saw that Naofumi can’t get into places like inns unless he’s in human form… so I want to be able to fight even when I’m in human form.”
“You fight in your Filolial form during battles, right?”
“Hmm… I’m not really sure.”
“You don’t know…?”
“Well… I do think a sword would suit you better than claws, young lady…”
“Yeah. Sakura, I want to try using a sword.”
“It’s good that you’re interested. What should we do?”
In response to the old man’s question, Father looks at me. It’s true that the Filolial-sama fight with their claws and their own unique weapons. So, personally, I respect Filolial-sama’s autonomy.

However, as things stand now, when it comes to weapons… we’re a bit short on cash. We’ve been spending money on all sorts of things. If we could do some peddling, that wouldn’t be an issue, and it’s also possible to earn money in Siltvelt.
“Well, we did take the equipment from the bandits who attacked us yesterday, so I think we can use that as a substitute…”
When my father looks over at Keel, Keel hands Sakura-chan a spare sword.
“Do you know how to use it?”
“I watched Keel-kun and learned how!”
“Ah, I see… So, Father, do you know of any place that sells equipment to turn Magical Power into threads?”
“Let me see… Maybe a magic shop would have something.”
“A magic shop?”
“It’s the biggest place around here that sells Magic Books and stuff. I think An-chan saw it on the way here, too.”
“Could that be the place over there that looks like a big bookstore?”
“Probably, yeah.”
“Got it. I’ll head over there, then.”
“If you tell them I sent you, they’ll give you a little discount, so give them some business.”
My dad handed Father a letter of introduction. And so, we headed toward the Magic shop.
